blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

lessons.title: The broken pack is supposed to fail

blocks.heading: The broken pack is supposed to fail
blocks.body:
`samples/kitepump-broken-map/` points at a file that is not there. Completeness should yell.

Copy it. Read the **first** row. Repair **that** row. Then run completeness again.

**XPath** is a search box for tags. Use it as a lamp if you want. It is not a career this week.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Completeness** :  a check that the booklet’s pointers match real files (and that ids match). A missing file is a row, not a vibe.

items.title: Do not
items.body: Do not restyle the PDF. Do not ‘clean up’ ten warnings before you fix the missing file. One error at a time.

cards.back: a check that the booklet’s pointers match real files (and that ids match). A missing file is a row, not a vibe

blocks.title: DITA Map Completeness Check
watchFor: What a missing file looks like vs a missing id

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You edit the repo sample in place and leave it broken, or you ignore the first error and ‘clean up’ unrelated warnings.

Expected: First error quoted. Check copy completeness clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Copy samples/kitepump-broken-map to oxygen-bootcamp-work/week8/broken/. Do not edit the sample in place.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Open kitepump-broken.ditamap in Maps Manager. Run completeness. Write the first error exactly in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week8/first-error.txt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: The pointer topics/missing-file.dita does not exist. Either restore a stub file with a matching id, or remove the topicref. Pick one and do it.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: If you want a lamp: the XPath toolbar searches tags. A simple search for title is enough. Write how many titles you saw. You do not need to become a programmer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Run completeness again. The check copy should be clean.

blocks.summary: First error quoted. Check copy completeness clean.

blocks.q: The first completeness error is a missing pointer. You should start by restyling the PDF. True or not?
options: Not true :  repair the book. The missing file is the error. Styles wait
True if the cover looks wrong
blocks.why: One error at a time. The first row is the job. Pretty is not this error.

blocks.q: You copied the broken pack, then repaired the copy. Why not edit the sample in place?
options: So tomorrow’s class still has a pack that fails on purpose
blocks.why: The broken pack is supposed to fail. Your copy is the one you fix.
